subject: Pro users can earn from communities — keep 70%
preview_text: Some owners now earn enough to cover their Pro many times over.
body_paragraphs: You've been Pro for a while and your picks are consistent. Time to flip the model: open your own tennis community on Predictify, set a small monthly price, and keep 70% of every subscription.
Top community owners are turning their picks into recurring income — and Predictify handles all the payment, hosting, and member management. You just keep predicting like you already do.
Setup is 90 seconds: pick a name, pick your angle (a tour, a player, a betting style), set a price or keep it free. Owners with a cover image grow 3x faster — we generate one for you in a tap.
